hero.desc: BAHRIA Group, a key player in maritime transport and logistics in Tunisia. Expertise, reliability and innovation at the service of your international trade.

s1.title: Maritime Transport
s1.desc: Complete management of your maritime freight operations. Bill of lading, ship consignment and real-time tracking across major Mediterranean ports.

s2.title: Customs Clearance
s2.desc: Our subsidiary Universal Transit handles all your import/export customs procedures. Full mastery of SINDA and TTN systems for fast and compliant clearance.

s3.title: Handling & Lifting
s3.desc: Bahria Schuch Maintenance, a German-Tunisian partnership since 2008, handles heavy load lifting and handling for logistics, industrial and oil sectors.

s4.title: Bonded Warehouse
s4.desc: Two approved bonded warehouses for temporary storage. Maximum security and optimal conservation conditions for up to 6 months.

s5.title: Land Transport
s5.desc: Complete multimodal solution with our own SCANIA truck fleet and SNCFT railway partnership for goods transport across all of Tunisia.

s6.title: Port Stevedoring
s6.desc: Stevedoring operations at Sousse and Bizerte ports via our subsidiary STUMAR. Loading, unloading and handling of all types of cargo.

about.title: Expertise forged at sea
about.p1: The Société Maritime du Centre (SMC Bahria) was founded on September 8, 2004 by Mr. Farhat Belgacem in Sousse. Equipped with an experienced team and modern technological resources, it has established itself as a key player in the Tunisian maritime sector.
about.p2: Strategically located in the Sidi Abdelhamid Industrial Zone and with a strong presence at the port of Bizerte through its subsidiary STUMAR, BAHRIA Group masters every link in the logistics chain.

s1.desc: The group's parent company. Maritime agency, transit, stevedoring and bonded warehouse management. Capital 3,230,280 TND.

s2.desc: Specialized in import/export customs clearance. Uses SINDA and TTN systems for fast and efficient procedures.

s3.desc: German-Tunisian partnership specialized in crane rental and heavy load handling for logistics, industrial and oil sectors.

s4.desc: Concessionaire at the port of Bizerte. Loading/unloading vessels and handling all types of cargo.

group.p1: BAHRIA Group is an integrated ecosystem of complementary subsidiaries that master every link in the logistics chain.
group.p2: Strategically located in Sousse and at the port of Bizerte, the group meets the most complex needs of Tunisian import-export.

cta.title: Ready to optimize your logistics?
cta.desc: Trust 20 years of Tunisian maritime expertise. Our team is at your disposal to study your needs and offer tailored solutions.

portal.desc: Access your personalized dashboard. Track your shipments, manage your customs documents and communicate with our teams from a single secure platform.
portal.f2: Management and download of your documents

documents.desc: Our team accompanies you in the preparation and management of all documents required for your import/export operations.

d1.name: Commercial Invoice
d1.desc: Basic document issued by the exporter specifying the nature, quantity and price of goods.

d2.name: Bill of Lading (B/L)
d2.desc: The only negotiable document in maritime transport. Proof of the transport contract and title of ownership.

d3.name: DDM
d3.desc: Detailed Goods Declaration filed with Tunisian customs authorities.

d4.name: Certificate of Origin
d4.desc: Certifies the origin of goods. Essential to benefit from preferential trade agreements.

d5.name: DAE
d5.desc: Removal Authorization Document issued after customs validation to collect the goods.

d6.name: Sanitary Certificate
d6.desc: Required for food, pharmaceutical or animal products. Issued by the competent authorities.

d7.name: Loading Manifest
d7.desc: Complete list of all goods loaded on board a vessel for a specific voyage.

d8.name: SINDA / TTN
d8.desc: Tunisian customs computer systems. Our subsidiary Universal Transit masters these platforms.

d9.name: Circulation Certificate
d9.desc: EUR.1 document facilitating preferential trade between Tunisia and the European Union.
